stem:
The phosphate buffer system operates in biological cells. The buffer contains dihydrogen phosphate, $\text{H}_2\text{PO}_4^-$, which acts as a weak acid.

$$\text{H}_2\text{PO}_4^- + \text{H}_2\text{O} \rightleftharpoons \text{HPO}_4^{2-} + \text{H}_3\text{O}^+$$

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Write an expression for the $K_a$ of $\text{H}_2\text{PO}_4^-$.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: Explain what is meant by the term buffer solution.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Write two equations to show how a solution containing a mixture of $\text{H}_2\text{PO}_4^-$ and $\text{HPO}_4^{2-}$ acts as a buffer.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
The pH in many living cells is 7.40.

$$\text{H}_2\text{PO}_4^- + \text{H}_2\text{O} \rightleftharpoons \text{HPO}_4^{2-} + \text{H}_3\text{O}^+ \qquad K_a = 6.31 \times 10^{-8}\text{ mol dm}^{-3}$$

Calculate the value of $[\text{HPO}_4^{2-}] / [\text{H}_2\text{PO}_4^-]$ needed to give a pH of 7.40 in the cells.

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.text: The $\text{H}_2\text{PO}_4^-$ ion can also act as a base.\n\nWrite an equation to show $\text{H}_2\text{PO}_4^-$ acting as a base.

parts.label: (d)(ii)
parts.text: The $\text{HPO}_4^{2-}$ ion can also act as an acid.\n\nWrite an equation to show $\text{HPO}_4^{2-}$ acting as an acid.
